_how_to: Who may see and do what in TRUST (docs/wiki/roles-and-permissions.md). Edit, save, deploy.

user_header: the name of the request header in which the access add-on passes each person's SAM_ACCOUNT. While it is empty, TRUST runs open: anyone past the add-on can do everything and types their name, and the page says so.
groups_header: the header with the person's AD groups (names or CN=... distinguished names). groups_separator: what separates them (a comma unless set).
groups: the AD groups for each role. A person in several groups gets every matching role. Group names are matched without regard to capitals.

data_sender: a team's service account that sends metric numbers (POST /api/metric-values). Put the account in this group; its SAM account must match the service account on the metric intake record. It sees no family data.

proxy_secret_header, proxy_secret_value: optional second lock. Name a header here, and put the secret value in the platform's environment setting TRUST_PROXY_SECRET (never in this file); the access add-on adds that header and value to every request it passes on. When both are set, a request without the right value is turned away, even if it names a person. Leave both empty to switch it off.
family_lead_groups: optional AD groups per L3 team id, for delegates; each L3 team's lead (the level-3 person in HR) is a team lead already.
Family members need no group: TRUST places them through HR, like their work.
WARNING: once user_header is set, anyone not in one of these groups, and not placed in a family, is turned away. To undo, empty user_header and deploy.
